name: 8th Angel ~Shuumatsu no Tenshi~
source:
World is in crisis, and in order to save it you must find and awaken eight angels. To do so, you will have to defeat as many monsters as you can while you develop your relationships with the seven female angels and with your sick step sister.

[from [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=508&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
世界正陷入危机。为了拯救世界，你必须找到八位天使，并唤醒她们。为此，你不仅要尽可能击败更多怪物，还要逐步培养自己与七位女性天使，以及体弱多病的继妹之间的感情。

[引自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=508&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
